findings.issue: Disabling command networking did not override an inherited true setting.
findings.resolution: Always pass the explicit network boolean to the selected command sandbox.
findings.evidence: test/sandbox.test.ts and a real MXC network-denial probe

findings.issue: workspace-write was described as restricting all host reads.
findings.resolution: Correct documentation. Add an isolated permission profile and explicit private-directory denial. The Windows app requires that profile and a real startup probe.
findings.evidence: src/sandbox.ts, src/sandbox-probe.ts, and the Windows manager startup gate

findings.issue: Development dependencies included vulnerable versions, including a template compiler and an unused bundled npm publisher.
findings.resolution: Update compatible transitive dependencies. Replace the unused npm publisher with a reviewed local workspace guard that refuses publication. Retain semantic-release for GitHub releases.

findings.issue: Parent-directory replacement needed an additional artifact path check.
findings.resolution: Revalidate resolved parent confinement after opening and comparing file identity.
findings.evidence: src/artifacts.ts and existing artifact confinement tests

findings.issue: A Windows distribution needed protected credentials and release-specific version metadata.
findings.resolution: Use per-user DPAPI and a restricted data directory. Stamp MSI, manager, runtime package, and manifest from the release tag. Pin downloaded binary hashes.

validation.dependencyAudit: Full production and development audit; zero findings
validation.unitAndIntegration: npm test -- --maxWorkers=2; release-tool tests also run under Node 24
validation.realSandbox: MXC: workspace writes succeed; private reads, private writes, and disabled networking are denied
validation.remoteTransport: Live Cloudflare OAuth and MCP check completed before installer work; named-token lifecycle has automated tests
validation.installer: Install, DPAPI and version self-test, bundled executable checks, and uninstall are required before release upload

limits: This is a single-owner service. Authorized clients share Codex jobs and workspace artifacts.
The generic workspace-write mode permits broader host reads. The Windows app uses isolated mode.
Native OS process isolation depends on the installed Codex version and Windows capabilities.
Read-only runtime paths remain visible. This is not a complete independent penetration test.
The MSI is unsigned without an operator-supplied signing certificate.
Quick Tunnel hostnames change across sessions. Named tunnel routing must be configured in Cloudflare.
